completed: Main and BridgeForward editors share the current account/student/version-bound save workflow, actual prompt catalog and truthful saved status.
Uncertain saves require explicit successful refresh; independent drafts and typing during a pending save are preserved. Departed saves cannot display success or private text in the current workspace.

Workspace panels and report readers share session-safe loading, current viewer intent and student selection links; failures remain explicit and signed-out/demo readers never request private responses.
Recognized BridgeForward questions and plain fallback labels replace raw prompt keys; unbacked static sample counts and simulated state toggles no longer appear in the signed-in editor.

New saves use current editing proof held through commit, increasing microsecond revisions and immutable student/prompt/recorded-creator identity. Read-only relationships can read without changing answers; Owner/admin requires explicit student proof and Partner-only is denied.
Old raw insert/update clients cannot bypass the current save protocol. Current-editor DELETE capability is preserved with transaction-held proof; ordinary TRUNCATE is revoked.
Existing legacy answers and recorded creators remain unchanged; complete reads exceed the REST row limit. All actual prompt/reading-level pairs and intentional clearing pass the database API.
